He not only did this for those who He knew would believe in Him, but He died for all us humans (1 John 2:2), even those that hate Him. Wow! This verse is showing us that God is love just like in 1 John 4:8. If a person says he loves God, but then doesn’t show that love to others, then he is not telling the truth, as if you truly have God’s love in you, it will make you love others. This is how you can tell if a person is truly born again, as they will show the fruit of unconditional love to others, and they will assure their eternal salvation by obeying Jesus (Hebrews 5:9). Thank you Lord for loving us so very much!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
